body: Punch reporting (bug 4): data change, not a sight check. perception.ron fight_hearing_radius 15->20 plus new civilian.ron reaction.fight_report_min_distance 15 (Fight no longer uses the 25 m gunshot min). Rejected: a line-of-sight fight stimulus up to corpse_sight - more rays and code in perceive for the same 18-20 m ring. Side effect: body_call_does_not_report_a_private_punch now spawns its witness after the fight stimulus expires (the old witness at ~18.9 m would hear the punch).
Star grey 0.82 with the drop shadow: on the hospital's white wall the earned star body matched the wall (only the shadow read, star looked hollow). Settled on 0.72.

t10.py: a second flake source besides the missed shot - CALLER_RANGE_M started at exactly report_min_distance 25, and the teleport tolerance put the caller at 24.99 m (GATE BROKEN in the forced-miss run). Range narrowed to 27..36 m. Retry of the kill (up to 4 spots, civilians off the line of fire) chosen over a health mutation: a non-player death has no Kill incident and would fail heat >= 40.

Earned star in the dark blink phase: new StarLook::Dim with an opaque dim fill (strings.ron hud.stars.dim_color 0.40) and the same drop shadow as the bright phase. Rejected: an outline-only look (Bevy text has shadow, no outline component used here; a hollow star needed a second glyph layer) and keeping off_color with the shadow (on the white wall the white-25% ghost body still matched the empty slots).

fight_report_min_distance < fight_hearing_radius: CivilianConfig::validate_fight_hearing called from compose_sim (same shape as WantedConfig::validate_call_delay); the fixture composes a copied config root with fight_report_min_distance 21 so dropping the call from compose_sim also goes RED. Rejected: a method-only fixture (misses the wiring).

Stars measured by MEDIAN glyph luma with phase from a 2-cluster split of slot-1 medians (gap 82), not the author max/min-frame mean |delta| (shadow rim inflates it). Rejected: reusing star_backdrops.py analysis. t10 1/10 red (stand spot blocked) filed Minor harness bug, AC3 graded PASS on 9 consecutive greens.
